title: ai settings / Reusable prompt files settings
content:
## Reusable prompt files settings | Setting and Description | Default | |------------------------|---------------| | `setting(chat.promptFilesLocations)` _(Deprecated)_
Configure prompt file locations for the Local harness. Use [prompt file migration](/docs/agent-customization/migrate-customizations.md#convert-prompt-files-to-skills) to convert prompts to skills. | `{ ".github/prompts": true }` | | `setting(chat.promptFilesRecommendations)`
Enable or disable prompt file recommendations when opening a new chat session. List of key-value pairs of prompt file name and boolean or when clause. | `[]` |
